milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.description: Stabilize local-first workflow contracts, evidence schemas, and baseline runtime gates.

prds.title: Workflow State and Schema Baseline
prds.description: Define and freeze typed workflow state contracts with migration-safe versioning.

prds.title: Evidence Artifact Contract
prds.description: Define canonical markdown/json evidence schema for e2e, revision, and release checks.

prds.title: Adapter Compatibility Test Harness
prds.description: Add contract tests for workflow adapters and provider boundary behavior.

milestones.title: MVP Authoring Loop
milestones.description: Deliver idea-to-first-draft and revision loop with explicit checkpoints and deterministic CLI flow.

prds.title: Guided Idea-to-Draft CLI Session
prds.description: Implement command-first guided run that takes idea input and produces first draft artifacts in one session.

prds.title: Checkpointed Revision Loop
prds.description: Guarantee no data loss across iterative revision rounds with explicit checkpoint persistence.

prds.title: Generation Control Surface
prds.description: Expose style, length, and constraint controls in CLI and persist parameter snapshots to evidence.

prds.title: Quality Feedback Pipeline
prds.description: Produce scene/chapter actionable feedback artifacts from critic and revision stages.

milestones.title: Consistency and Release Gate
milestones.description: Add narrative consistency checks and enforce chapter release gate with zero critical conflicts.

prds.title: Narrative Entity Model
prds.description: Define canonical character, worldbuilding, and timeline entity schema used by consistency checks.

prds.title: Consistency Conflict Detector
prds.description: Implement conflict detection and severity tagging for entity and timeline contradictions.

prds.title: Chapter Release Gate Scoring
prds.description: Implement deterministic chapter gate with score threshold, critical blockers, and evidence linkage.

milestones.title: Team Workflow and Ergonomics
milestones.description: Harden deterministic stage handoff for small teams and improve mixed CLI/UI operability.

prds.title: Role-Aware Stage Handoff
prds.description: Add role boundaries and deterministic stage ownership for team collaboration.

prds.title: Conflict Triage Workflow
prds.description: Add structured triage, fix-status tracking, and escalation for consistency and quality issues.

prds.title: Optional UI Execution Bridge
prds.description: Provide optional desktop/ui bridge for the same deterministic workflow stages exposed by CLI.

milestones.title: Optimization and Evidence Analytics
milestones.description: Achieve KPI targets and expose auditable quality/cycle-time evidence summaries.

prds.title: KPI Measurement Specification
prds.description: Freeze measurement rules for cycle-time baseline, sample windows, and comparable quality rubric.

prds.title: Cycle-Time Reduction Dashboard Artifacts
prds.description: Produce weekly evidence summaries showing cycle-time trend and quality comparability.

prds.title: Release Readiness Automation
prds.description: Automate release evidence completeness checks and gate enforcement before publish.

milestones.title: Writing Helper Capability Parity
milestones.description: Close remaining writing-helper gaps: editor UX, export, text-humanization optimizer, detector-oriented statistics, and multi-LLM provider surface.

prds.title: Built-in Real-time Editor and Draft Rewrite
prds.description: Provide built-in real-time editing for generated drafts with deterministic save/reload and revision linkage.

prds.title: Deep Style Prompt Composer
prds.description: Provide multi-dimensional style composition controls for language, structure, narration, and emotion with reusable presets.

prds.title: Markdown One-click Export Experience
prds.description: Add one-click markdown export from draft/revision artifacts with stable file naming and trace metadata.

prds.title: AI Text Humanization Optimizer
prds.description: Add optimizer pipeline to reduce AI-like writing traces while preserving meaning and narrative intent.

prds.title: Detector-oriented Statistics Optimization
prds.description: Introduce measurable perplexity/burstiness optimization and detector-facing validation strategy.

prds.title: Multi-LLM Provider Matrix (OpenAI/Grok/Ollama/DeepSeek)
prds.description: Extend provider integration and routing to include Grok/Ollama/DeepSeek with per-provider capability constraints.

prds.title: API Configuration UX and Timeout/Debug Ergonomics
prds.description: Provide intuitive API settings UX, long-timeout handling (up to 10 minutes), and user-friendly error/debug surfaces.

prds.title: Responsive UI and Mobile Adaptation
prds.description: Ensure desktop/mobile responsive behavior for editor, optimization controls, provider settings, and run feedback views.

milestones.title: Novel Profiles and Genre-Adaptive Quality Gates
milestones.description: Add per-novel custom reference libraries, genre-adaptive rubrics, and optional hard gates for historical/detail-sensitive projects.

prds.title: Novel Profile and Scoped Reference Library
prds.description: Introduce per-novel profile contracts with project-scoped reference library manifests and source provenance.

prds.title: Genre Taxonomy and Adaptive Rubric Packs
prds.description: Define canonical genre taxonomy and map each genre to rubric packs for quality scoring.

prds.title: Historical Detail Scorecard
prds.description: Implement history-detail scorecard dimensions (ritual, clothing, institution, chronology) with evidence output.

prds.title: Genre-Aware Gate Policy
prds.description: Add per-profile gate policy (hard_gate/warn_only) and integrate rubric-based block semantics into release checks.

milestones.title: Operational Parity and Compatibility Hardening
milestones.description: Preserve old-solution operational strengths via release-governance hardening, gateway contract compatibility, and desktop parity checks.

prds.title: Release Readiness Gate Contract Hardening
prds.description: Freeze and test deterministic GO/NO_GO blocker semantics for baseline tests/coverage, desktop checks, and gate-score critical blockers.

prds.title: MCP Gateway Backward-Compatibility Guard
prds.description: Protect chat/stream/health/tools/models endpoint contracts and compatibility-critical helpers with deterministic regression tests.

prds.title: Desktop Quality-Gate Parity Enforcement
prds.description: Enforce desktop typecheck/build parity as release-facing signal when optional UI delivery is in scope.

prds.title: Mode Orchestration and Quality-First Policy Enforcement
prds.description: Enforce manual-enable auto-writing modes and make docs/quality criteria authoritative across manual/hybrid/full-auto workflows.

milestones.title: Roadmap Continuity and KPI Governance
milestones.description: Finalize roadmap governance after capability-parity delivery and track ongoing KPI, release, and quality-policy stewardship.

prds.title: Roadmap Governance and Lifecycle Sync
prds.description: Maintain roadmap pointers, milestone lifecycle semantics, and deterministic PRD activation/completion updates.

prds.title: KPI and Evidence Governance Baseline
prds.description: Operationalize continuous KPI evidence refresh and weekly quality/release artifact governance.

prds.title: Quality Policy Drift Guard
prds.description: Detect and prevent runtime-policy drift from docs/quality acceptance criteria and release-gate blocker semantics.

milestones.title: Release Blocker Resolution
milestones.description: Close remaining P0 desktop release blocker so policy-conformant release readiness can move from NO_GO to GO when all gates pass.

prds.title: Desktop Typecheck Gate Recovery
prds.description: Eliminate desktop TypeScript failures that keep release gate at NO_GO and enforce deterministic blocker-to-gate mapping evidence.

milestones.title: Release Semantics Closure
milestones.description: Complete post-M9 release semantic closure by validating deterministic GO transitions and auditable evidence alignment after desktop blocker recovery.

prds.title: Deterministic GO Transition Verification
prds.description: Verify release decision transitions from NO_GO to GO under fully passing checks while preserving blocker semantics and decision reduction determinism.

prds.title: Post-Recovery Evidence Contract Refresh
prds.description: Refresh and validate release evidence artifacts so recovered desktop_check state is traceable and schema-compatible across summary and release artifacts.

milestones.title: Release Contract Observability Hardening
milestones.description: Strengthen deterministic release-contract observability by extending artifact assertions, provenance checks, and regression guards for future release cycles.

prds.title: Artifact Provenance and Cross-Surface Mapping
prds.description: Ensure release report and artifact expose stable provenance mappings for key blocker signals and evidence links.

prds.title: Deterministic Reason Attribution Guardrail
prds.description: Expand regression tests to guarantee blocker reason attribution remains precise across mixed-pass/fail scenarios.

prds.title: Evidence Freshness and Trace Consistency Closure
prds.description: Harden freshness and trace-link consistency checks so release evidence remains auditable over repeated runs.

milestones.title: Release Contract Runtime Resilience
milestones.description: Harden runtime path guarantees so release-check contracts remain deterministic under CLI command evolution and session orchestration changes.

prds.title: CLI Runtime Route Determinism Guard
prds.description: Protect runtime command routing so guided-draft/runtime command surfaces remain deterministic and backward-safe.

prds.title: Session Trace and Artifact Continuity Guard
prds.description: Ensure session_id/run_id/trace links stay continuous and cross-surface consistent through runtime orchestration paths.

prds.title: Roadmap-to-PRD Activation Recovery Guard
prds.description: Add deterministic recovery checks for pointer transitions when roadmap advances and active PRD switches after closure.

milestones.title: Roadmap Lifecycle Integrity Automation
milestones.description: Automate roadmap lifecycle event integrity so activation and closure traces remain deterministic, deduplicated, and machine-auditable.

prds.title: Roadmap Lifecycle Event Integrity Guard
prds.description: Add deterministic guards for lifecycle event ordering, duplicate-action prevention, and pointer-state consistency in roadmap changelog updates.

prds.title: Roadmap UpdatedAt and Completion Timestamp Consistency Guard
prds.description: Ensure roadmap-level updatedAt and milestone/PRD completion timestamps remain synchronized and monotonic across lifecycle updates.

prds.title: Roadmap Lifecycle Regression Evidence Export Guard
prds.description: Export deterministic lifecycle regression evidence for roadmap transitions with cross-surface parity between changelog and release artifacts.
